cur-fossil-santa-cruz.dateNote: In 1887 Carlos Ameghino began collecting along the Santa Cruz River in Patagonia, Argentina, for his brother Florentino. The rocks are packed with ground sloths, glyptodonts and "terror birds", about 18–16 million years old (Early Miocene). Wikidata pins the formation at a rounded point.
cur-fossil-santa-cruz.summary: Patagonian cliffs full of strange South American mammals and giant "terror birds".
